claims: The Artemis II mission launches on April 1, 2026.
Live coverage of the Artemis II mission starts around 12:50 p.m. ET.
The primary free viewing options are NASA+, the NASA App, and the NASA YouTube channel.
Official NASA Coverage starts at 12:50 p.m. ET.
Official NASA Coverage is available on NASA+, YouTube, and social media platforms.
CBS News provides 4 p.m. ET coverage.
CBS News features a special report with live coverage on CBS News 24/7, local stations, and YouTube.
NBC News NOW is a 24/7 stream.
NBC News NOW is accessible via NBCNews.com, YouTube, and Peacock.
C-SPAN offers all-day live coverage from Kennedy Space Center.
FOX Weather provides coverage of the countdown and launch on YouTube.
The New York Times provides live streaming and updates on their website.
Tickets for viewing from the Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex are sold out.
NASA’s official broadcast coverage will continue throughout the 10-day mission.
